the quality of submitted new product ideas is higher when customers are highly dissatisfied, have a high level creativity, and have a high level commitment to the brand.
the quality of submitted new product ideas is positively related to customer creativity and customer latent dissatisfaction with existing offerings.

the effectiveness of virtual 'co creation' with customers in the early stages (i.e. the idea generation phase) of new product development.
the effectiveness of virtual 'co creation' with customers in new product development, and the contingent conditions under which it is effective.

how virtual 'co creation' activities can be effectively designed in the context of new product development, which customer characteristics are most likely to produce high quality ideas and how brand relationships can influence the outcomes of virtual co creation.

the effectiveness of virtual customer co creation is not only determined by the quality of the customers but also by their relationship to the company.
the quality of submitted customer ideas is positively influenced by customer creativity and brand relationship strength and negatively influenced by customer latent dissatisfaction.

virtual co creation is a promising way to engage customers in the early stages (i.e. ideation) of NPD, but that the design aspects of virtual ideation activities are not as important as the customer and brand relationship characteristics.

the quality of submitted customer ideas is mainly determined by the characteristics of customers and their relationship with the company.

the effectiveness of virtual 'co creation' in the early stages (i.e. the idea generation stage) of the new product development process is not dependent on the design of virtual co creation tools but rather on the customers' motivation to participate in such activities.
customers who have a strong brand relationship and are dissatisfied with existing products are more likely to come up with high-quality ideas in a virtual co creation setting.

virtual co creation activities can indeed be a powerful way for companies to integrate customers into NPD activities, especially in the early stages.
